title: Ashbury Rewards Missing Stay Claim Limits
content:
Two Ashbury Rewards limits bound the late crediting of a stay: the number of calendar days after check-out within which a missing stay can still be credited, and how far before the enrolment date a stay's check-out may fall and still be credited.

| Tier | Calendar days after check-out within which a missing stay can be credited | Calendar days before the enrolment date within which a stay's check-out may fall and still be credited |
|---|---|---|
| Ashbury Rewards Member | 180 | 30 |
| Ashbury Rewards Silver Elite | 180 | 30 |
| Ashbury Rewards Gold Elite | 180 | 30 |
| Ashbury Rewards Platinum Elite | 180 | 30 |
| Ashbury Rewards Titanium Elite | 180 | 30 |
| Ashbury Rewards Ambassador Elite | 180 | 30 |

Both limits are the same at all six tiers: 180 calendar days after check-out, and 30 calendar days before enrolment.

**Reading the card (hypothetical member).** A member enrolled on a hypothetical 1 June. A stay whose check-out fell 30 calendar days before 1 June is inside the 30-day limit; a stay whose check-out fell 31 calendar days before is outside it.
